sentences.text:
Present: Mr. Ajay Kochhar,
Senior Advocate, assisted by of Mr. Anirudh Thakur, Advocate, for the applicant.
Mr. H.S. Rawat, Additional A.G., for the rt respondent/State.
Cr. M.P. No. 52 of 2026
By way of present application, indulgence of this Court has been sought to implead the child victim through natural guardian, in the present case.
Application considered and allowed.
The child victim through her natural guardian is impleaded as respondent No. 2, in this case.
In order to conceal her identity, she is referred to here as ABC (prosecutrix), D/o XXX, R/o YYY.
Application is disposed of accordingly.
Notice.
Mr. H.S. Rawat, Additional A.G., appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the respondent/State.
Put up after respite, enabling the State to file status report.
( Virender Singh ) Judge 2nd January, 2026 (Pramod) .
Called again.

Present: Mr. Ajay Kochhar, Senior Advocate, assisted by Mr. Anirudh Thakur, Advocate,
for the of applicant.
Mr. H.S. Rawat, Additional A.G., for the rt respondent/State.
Status report filed.
Be taken on record.
Copy supplied.
For consideration, to come up on 09.01.2026.

Till then, Police/Investigating Officer is directed not to take any coercive action against the applicant, qua FIR No. 117 of 2025 dated 24.12.2025, registered under Sections 376, 506 of Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, registered with Police Station Rampur, District Shimla, H.P.
